# cpanel_mime_type (Resource)

Manages one custom cPanel Apache MIME type and its file extensions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_mime_type" "manifest" {
  type       = "application/manifest+json"
  extensions = [".webmanifest"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extensions` (Set of String) The file extensions associated with the MIME type. Each extension must begin with a dot.
- `type` (String) The lowercase custom media type, for example `application/x-example`.

### Read-Only

- `origin` (String) The MIME type owner reported by cPanel. Managed entries report `user`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_mime_type.manifest application/manifest+json
```
